summary: Claude's pricing page lists Enterprise at US$20 per seat per month, billed annually, with a 20-seat minimum. Usage is not included in the seat price and is billed at API rates.

ChatGPT Work and Codex help states GPT-6.2 Ultrafast billing: on Pro 500, included allowance draws down at 6x Standard and purchased credits are a promotional 3x Standard rate through 28 February 2027. Pro 200 includes GPT-6.2 Sol Ultrafast in Codex on those rates. GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol stay at 8x included and 6x on credits.
OpenAI help says that starting in December, Plus, Pro, and Business usage will be one shared token allowance across ChatGPT and Codex. Instant chat will not draw from that usage.
